mentions.name: Pagey
mentions.description: A 100% free static site hosting platform with no strings attached, suitable for quickly built ("vibe-coded") websites. It hosts more than 11,000 sites for 4,500+ users five months after launch and is actively run and improved almost daily.
mentions.audience: Vibe coders looking for free hosting for their projects
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://pagey.site - A 100% free static site hosting for all your (and mine) vibe-coded slop. Truly 100% free. No strings attached.

As of now, it hosts more than 11K sites and 4.5K+ users within just 5 months of launch.

mentions.name: Pagey
mentions.description: Static site hosting service where users upload an HTML file or a zip containing HTML plus other needed files, and the site is hosted on a subdomain with full HTTPS. Supports optional password protection, shareable links, and detailed analytics.
mentions.source_excerpt:
So, I built this:

https://pagey.site

Simple static site hosting. Upload html or a zip-containing-html along with other needed files, and it gets hosted on a subdomain with full https. Optionally, password protect it, or generate shareable links. Also, detailed analytics and other stuff.
